Welcome to the School of Computing

The School of Computing at Maduka University is a dynamic and forward-thinking faculty dedicated to producing world-class computing professionals. Established as one of the cornerstone schools of Maduka University, we offer a vibrant academic environment where technology, creativity, and critical thinking converge.

Our programmes are fully accredited by the National Universities Commission (NUC) and are designed to meet the demands of Nigeria's rapidly evolving digital economy. We are committed to equipping every student with the technical skills, ethical grounding, and professional mindset needed to excel in the global technology industry.

Our Core Values

These values define who we are, how we operate, and what we expect from every student, lecturer, and staff member of the School of Computing.

01 —
Academic Excellence
We pursue and uphold the highest standards of academic rigour, intellectual curiosity, and scholarly achievement in everything we do.
02 —
Integrity
We operate with honesty, transparency, and strong ethical principles — in our research, our relationships, and our professional practice.
03 —
Innovation
We encourage creative thinking and problem-solving, pushing boundaries to develop solutions that address real challenges facing Nigeria and the world.
04 —
Community
We foster a strong sense of belonging, mutual support, and collaboration — because the best technology is built by people who work well together.
05 —
Industry Relevance
Our curriculum is continuously aligned with global and Nigerian industry standards so every graduate is job-ready from day one.
06 —
Service
We are committed to using technology as a force for good — serving our communities, our nation, and the African continent with purpose.

Our Vision

"To be the foremost School of Computing in Nigeria, recognised for producing world-class technology professionals, groundbreaking research, and meaningful contributions to Africa's digital transformation."

Our vision is not just aspirational — it is a commitment we make to every student who walks through our doors. We are building the infrastructure, the faculty, the partnerships, and the culture required to make Maduka School of Computing a name synonymous with computing excellence across Africa.

We envision a school where every graduate is a global competitor, where research moves from classroom to industry, and where the name "Maduka University's School of Computing" opens doors in Lagos, London, and Silicon Valley alike.

Nigeria's next generation of tech leaders starts here.
From Enugu to the world — the School of Computing is building something that will outlast all of us.

Our Mission

"To provide a rigorous, innovative, and inclusive computing education that empowers students with the technical skills, ethical values, and professional mindset to lead Nigeria's digital future."

Our mission guides every decision we make — from how we design our curriculum to how we support students inside and outside the classroom. We are not just here to teach programming and theory. We are here to transform lives, build careers, and produce graduates who make a real difference.

Mission in Action

Industry-Aligned Curriculum
Courses designed with input from Nigerian and global tech employers to ensure real-world relevance.
Hands-On Learning
State-of-the-art computer labs, cybersecurity servers, and practical projects that build real skills.
Research & Innovation
Active research culture with projects in AI, cybersecurity, and software engineering.
Student Community
Thriving clubs, societies, and student-led initiatives that build professional networks early.
Qualified Faculty
Experienced lecturers with academic credentials and industry backgrounds who invest in every student.
Student Welfare
Dedicated welfare channels ensuring every student's voice is heard and concerns are addressed promptly.

Our Departments

The School of Computing runs three NUC-accredited undergraduate programmes, each designed to produce highly skilled professionals ready for Nigeria's digital economy.

CSC — B.Sc
Computer Science
A comprehensive study of computation theory, algorithms, data structures, artificial intelligence, and software systems. The foundation for everything computing.
Learn More on Academics
SEN — B.Sc
Software Engineering
Focused on the full software development lifecycle — from requirements and design to deployment and maintenance. Build real products that work at scale.
Learn More on Academics
CYB — B.Sc
Cybersecurity
Specialised training in network security, ethical hacking, digital forensics, and cyber defence. Nigeria's most in-demand computing specialisation.
Learn More on Academics

Rules & Regulations

Every student, staff member, and visitor of the School of Computing is expected to abide by these rules at all times. Violations may result in disciplinary action.

Rule 01
Students must maintain a minimum attendance of 75% in all courses to qualify for end-of-semester examinations.
Rule 02
All forms of academic dishonesty — including plagiarism, cheating, and impersonation — are strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disciplinary action.
Rule 03
Students must adhere to the approved faculty dress code at all times within school premises. See the Dress Code section for full details.
Rule 04
All laboratory equipment must be handled with care. Any damage caused by negligence will be the responsibility of the student involved.
Rule 05
Mobile phones must be silenced during lectures. Unauthorized use of devices during examinations is a serious offence.
Rule 06
Students are expected to treat all members of the faculty — lecturers, staff, and fellow students — with respect and courtesy at all times.
Rule 07
Departmental dues must be paid in full before students can access certain faculty resources, sit for examinations, or participate in school events.
Rule 08
The use of the school's computer laboratories is restricted to academic purposes only. Unauthorized software installation is prohibited.
Print / save Rules & Regulations as PDF

Dress Code

The School of Computing has an approved dress code that all students must observe on school premises. Two approved combinations are permitted.

Black Top
Grey Bottom
Combination A — Black & Grey
Black top (corporate shirts and blouse) paired with grey trousers or skirt. This is the most commonly worn combination and the default for formal school events.
Approved
White Top
Coffee Brown
Combination B — White & Coffee Brown
White top (corporate shirts or blouse) paired with coffee brown trousers or skirt. Ideal for hotter days and equally acceptable for all school occasions when specified.
Approved
Important Note
Students found in violation of the dress code may be asked to leave the premises until they return in appropriate attire. Repeated violations will be escalated to the HOD. Picture examples will be added once provided.
